frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original low-poly interpretation of the shell exterior and visible aperture of PRI 69688, not an exact scan or living-animal reconstruction. UF 247451 is corroborating species morphology only, not the source of this specimen scale.

scale.basis: PRI69688 three-view photograph: its 5 mm vertical bar is about 39 px; shell image height roughly 220 px gives approximately 28 mm. Width/depth are working estimates from oblique views, not caliper measurements.
scale.uncertainty: Approximate visual scale; allow about 15% proportional interpretation. No specimen-exact biometric claim. Do not use the distinct 4 cm UF247451 scale or PRI70745 3.5 cm as PRI69688 measurements.

simplifications: Fine growth lines may be omitted; gentle broad low-poly facets are enough.
Natural staining, chips, museum writing and exact taphonomic imperfections are not required.
Do not reconstruct soft body, operculum, deep internal coils, siphonal canal, or biological colors.
Use restrained warm fossil-ivory/stone palette; this is artistic, not inferred living coloration.
